fields.description:
**Background**

As we are rebuilding Class Utilization to just show class detail we need to add a new Appointment Utilization dashboard. Appointments are not as widely used and even less so among multi-location customers. The dashboard should provide insights into appointments but does not need same level of detail as with Class Utilization. We can add to it in future based on customer feedback.

Proposal = we create new Appointment Utilization dashboard (No class data) with below tabs

* Summary Tab (5 KPIs (with prior month & prior year data) and 2 visualizations (Appointments held held and Total booked, 13 months)
* By Location/Trainer/Program
* By Trainer & by Program
* Trending data over time (monthly) for Attendance %, No Show%, Booked Time % (13 months)
* Documentation tab

Advanced Filters to include below filters. 

Country, State, Membership Name, Plan name, Program Name, Trainer, Day of week    
Use Similar Layout as Class Utilization New Dashboard

[Metrics](https://abcfinancial-my.sharepoint.com/:x:/g/personal/eoin_george_abcfitness_com/IQARQMd8ron0QqnfIJRHA_xDAQ4jgMscHVOadSTBmIw2ldU?e=aTrGBS) (2nd tab)
